Title: Rohan and the Family

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Zoya - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Sonali - 38 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Isha - 11 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Vimla - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Sonali stands near him.]

Rohan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Rohan claps his hands.]

Rohan: "That was fun!"

[Rohan shakes his head.]

Sonali (gently): "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Rohan stands in the park. Zoya and Sonali stand near him.]

Rohan: "So, here we are!"

[Rohan goes jogging in the park.]

Zoya: "That's great!"

[Rohan catches the ball.]

Zoya: "How beautiful!"

[Rohan does push-ups.]

Rohan (surprised): "How beautiful!"

[Zoya skips rope.]

Zoya (excited): "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Rohan stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's begin."

[Rohan knocks on the door.]

Rohan (gently): "What next?"

[Rohan opens the door and goes out.]

Rohan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Rohan slams the door shut.]

Sonali: "Hey, look at that!"

[Rohan opens the window.]

Rohan: "What a day to remember!"
